# Theory: Git is Already Distributed; Forges are Not

Every clone is a replica of objects. Federation of *issues and PRs* needs extra protocols (ForgeFed, ActivityPub) or boring mirroring.

## Invariants

1. Mirroring is practical federation of Git objects.
2. Cross-instance PRs are still experimental.
3. Radicle and similar try to drop the forge as a single host.

```text
clone A  ←→  clone B     (Git, solved)
forge A  ─?─  forge B     (issues/PRs, unsolved at scale)
```

## What can break

- Assuming Codeberg and GitHub issues sync because remotes do.

## How to read this chapter

Git as primitive, federated hosting, readiness.
